title: Harmine-mediated Reduction of Bone Cancer Pain in Rats Correlates With Suppressed DYRK1A/NF-kappaB Signaling Axis.
authors: Zhang, Shuyao; Zheng, Shang; Jin, Jia; Li, Yuhua; Chen, Liping; Lin, Junjie; Yao, Ming; Xu, Longsheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Harmine缓解骨癌痛大鼠的镇痛机制，涉及DYRK1A/NF-kB信号通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Bone cancer pain (BCP) is a prevalent chronic pain condition and a common clinical symptom in patients with advanced cancer. It significantly affects the mobility and quality of life of patients; however, current treatments offer limited efficacy. Harmine, a beta-carboline alkaloid extracted from Peganum harmala, exhibits anti-inflammatory, anxiolytic, analgesic, and neuroprotective properties. However, its antinociceptive properties and mechanisms in BCP models remain unclear. This study aimed to systematically investigate the analgesic effects of Harmine in rats with BCP and explore its underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: Using databases such as SwissTargetPrediction and Polypharmacology Browser, molecular docking analysis, behavioral tests, and biochemical analysis, we comprehensively evaluated the effects of Harmine in the BCP model. RESULTS: The results demonstrated that Harmine significantly alleviated BCP induced by Luciferin-Malignant Atypical Discrete Breast 106 cells (LUC-MADB106) in a dose-dependent manner. Intrathecal administration of Harmine significantly inhibited the upregulation of dual-specificity tyrosine phosphorylation-regulated kinase 1A (DYRK1A) expression and the activation of the nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells (NF-kappaB) pathway in the spinal cord dorsal horn (SCDH) of rats with bone cancer. CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest that Harmine has significant therapeutic potential for alleviating BCP hyperalgesia, providing a foundation for the future development of new drugs targeting BCP.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨癌痛（BCP）是一种常见的慢性疼痛状态，也是晚期癌症患者常见的临床症状。它显著影响患者的活动能力和生活质量；然而，当前治疗方法的疗效有限。骆驼蓬碱（Harmine）是从骆驼蓬（Peganum harmala）中提取的一种β-咔啉生物碱，具有抗炎、抗焦虑、镇痛和神经保护特性。然而，其在BCP模型中的抗伤害性作用及其机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在系统探讨骆驼蓬碱在骨癌痛大鼠中的镇痛效果，并探索其潜在的分子机制。方法：利用SwissTargetPrediction和Polypharmacology Browser等数据库、分子对接分析、行为测试和生化分析，我们全面评估了骆驼蓬碱在BCP模型中的作用。结果：结果表明，骆驼蓬碱以剂量依赖性方式显著缓解由荧光素酶-恶性非典型离散乳腺106细胞（LUC-MADB106）诱导的BCP。鞘内注射骆驼蓬碱显著抑制了骨癌大鼠脊髓背角（SCDH）中双特异性酪氨酸磷酸化调节激酶1A（DYRK1A）表达的上调以及核因子κB（NF-kappaB）通路的激活。结论：这些发现表明，骆驼蓬碱在缓解BCP痛觉过敏方面具有显著的治疗潜力，为未来开发针对BCP的新药奠定了基础。
